title: Stack Scout // Updates
summary: Public-safe activity stream seeded from official or first-party sources.

items.title: Claude’s desktop apps get HTML-in-Canvas. Cue the Flash nostalgia.
items.summary: Felix Rieseberg says Claude’s desktop apps now support HTML-in-Canvas; his explainer describes melting text that stays selectable.

items.title: Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM
items.summary: Dreamteam has signed up more than 100 customers across 13 countries, with some businesses switching from established CRMs.

items.title: code_star calls foul on a blog’s claims about Ricursive and ‘laddering’
items.summary: code_star disputes apparent invention claims about “laddering,” while natolambert says the unnamed blog reads like AI-generated filler.

items.title: Timnit Gebru warns against letting Pangram play authorship judge
items.summary: Gebru shared Emily M. Bender’s critique of AI-detection verdicts, while a critic defended detectors’ potential for near-zero false positives.

items.title: SemiAnalysis reportedly cuts 2028 AI accelerator spending forecast by 28%, per @firstadopter
items.summary: @firstadopter says a reported client note cites slower frontier-lab growth and tightening capital markets.

items.title: Google pitches Gemini Decisions API: up to 1,000 questions, one pass
items.summary: Google says its new model evaluates text, images, audio, video and PDFs with no output-token charges.

items.title: Baconbrix says Grok urged a hospital visit for a possible collapsed lung
items.summary: Baconbrix credits Grok with flagging a possible collapsed lung, saying they were about to undergo surgery.

items.title: Miwo’s next chapter is coming soon, creator Tarin Clanuwat says
items.summary: JapanGov reports miwo transcribes old Japanese script from photos, with 20-language support in development.

items.title: Apple launches health AI study, not a doctor in your pocket
items.summary: Apple’s OpenEvidence study seeks up to 200,000 eligible U.S. adults to explore health AI trust, comprehension and optional HealthKit sharing.

items.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
items.summary: Apple's new app for a study will answer everyday medical questions

items.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
items.summary: Bharat Semi says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies including General Atomics.

items.title: Is bad news for Jensen Huang also bad news for the AI industry?
items.summary: "Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia."

items.title: SNL gathers all the tech tycoons for a lesson in dating and spycraft
items.summary: While awkward, creepy tech executives have become a recurring theme on Saturday Night Live, this week’s episode gave the cast a chance to show off all their impressions at once.

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch.

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.summary: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Make opened its CLI to all users
items.summary: Make's 2026 release notes show the Make CLI becoming available to all users, continuing the platform's expansion beyond the browser UI.

items.title: GitHub MCP Server reached 1.0.0
items.summary: The official GitHub MCP server hit 1.0.0 with granular issue field tooling and broader MCP Apps support behind feature flags.

items.title: GitHub CLI 2.90.0 introduced `gh skill` in public preview
items.summary: The latest GitHub CLI release adds search, install, preview, update, and publish flows for portable agent skills.

items.title: Hugging Face added Kernels to the Hub
items.summary: The Hub changelog added Kernels as a new way to browse precompiled, hardware-specific kernels and also continues to push agent traces into the product story.

items.title: Strudel Studio's latest public pass focused on smoke-run reliability
items.summary: The recent manager-side pass caught and fixed a release-smoke issue while keeping the studio workflow moving forward.

items.title: Canvas Planner stayed clean and review-ready in its latest public pass
items.summary: The latest public-ready manager pass kept the board surface fast and uncluttered while tightening browser behavior.

items.title: Playwright MCP 0.0.70 landed as the latest maintenance release
items.summary: The current tagged release is a maintenance cut, while the docs continue to push Playwright MCP as a first-class browser layer for agent workflows.

items.title: n8n kept its March 2026 release line moving
items.summary: The March release notes show continued 1.12x shipping, while docs and blog updates highlight secrets-provider and workflow-hardening work.

items.title: OpenAI launched GPT-5.4
items.summary: GPT-5.4 arrived with native computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context, reinforcing OpenAI's focus on real agent workflows.

items.title: Perplexity doubled down on its product thesis in March 2026
items.summary: Perplexity's public blog framed 'The AI is the Computer' and kept tying that story to its API and device ambitions from late February.

items.title: Anthropic's current system-card set centers Claude Sonnet 4.6
items.summary: Anthropic's model materials list Claude Sonnet 4.6 as the current Sonnet generation and explicitly note API access among the active surfaces.

items.title: Wrangler 4.58.0 improved command grouping and auth ergonomics
items.summary: Cloudflare's Workers SDK release added grouped help categories, better auth token retrieval, and type generation on dev startup.
